summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as keyword-based rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py) with matching unit-test modules in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. All 71 ECS tests pass, and the wider test/unit/rules suite (987 tests) passes. Nothing was committed. The reference venv has an editable install pointing at a different checkout, so I ran tests with PYTHONPATH set to this repo's src; the venv was not modified. black and ruff are not in the venv, so formatting was checked only by line length (one over-length line was fixed); the code has not been run through black or ruff.
